GAGMO Company Limited supports mines and quarries, moves freight by road, collects hazardous waste and builds roads and railways across Tanzania.

Request a quoteSee what we do

What we do

Six lines of work, one Mwanza-based team. Tell us what your site needs and we will tell you how we can help.

  • Collection of hazardous waste

    We collect hazardous waste from mining, industrial and commercial sites and take it away safely. Proper handling protects your workers, the surrounding community and the environment.

    Ask about this service

  • Mining and quarrying support

    Mines and quarries need more than machines. We support mining and quarrying operations with tools, equipment and the supporting services that keep a site working. Tell us what is missing on your site and we will help you source it.

    Ask about this service

  • Freight transport by road

    We move equipment, materials and goods by road to mining sites, construction projects and businesses. Reliable scheduling and careful handling mean your cargo arrives safely and on time.

    Ask about this service

  • Other food service activities

    Teams working on remote sites need good meals. We provide food and catering services so crews stay fed and focused on the job.

    Ask about this service

  • Transportation support

    Beyond hauling, transport depends on many supporting activities such as coordination, loading and logistics. We handle these tasks so your operations keep moving without delays.

    Ask about this service

  • Roads and railways

    We take part in building roads and railways, the links that connect mines, towns and markets. Good infrastructure cuts travel time and opens up new areas for business.

    Ask about this service

A Tanzanian company built for the mining trade

GAGMO Company Limited supplies mining tools and equipment and offers services that mines, quarries and contractors depend on. Our giraffe and mountain mark stands for what we aim for: seeing far, working steady and staying close to Tanzania.

Vision

To be a trusted Tanzanian supplier of mining tools, equipment and services, known for reliability, safety and care for the communities and environment where we work.

Mission

To supply quality mining tools and equipment and deliver dependable services in mining support, transport, waste collection and construction, so our customers can work safely and productively.
